visual_review: All34 rendered cut frames directly inspected; subject and keyword match, no extra keyword labels. Approved source clips reused. Car wide shots shorter than4s.

alignment_review.method: Phrase-level video cue timing, not word-level karaoke. Official timestamps reconciled with independent ASR, repeated musical sections and vocal-stem inspection; whole-phrase tokens deliberately used because only two keyword labels are rendered.
limitations: Independent ASR confuses repeated sound words; its match percentage is not a music-quality or comprehension score.
Automated listening describes arrangement but does not establish user satisfaction.

user_satisfaction: Not measured; agent selection is not individual user acceptance.
